findings.disposition_note: In the rendered PNG the label does not overlap the markers and both stay legible; recorded for a future redraw only.
findings.summary: The 'unperturbed' direct label sits only about 4-5 px above the filled-marker row (its descender ends near row 393 and the marker crowns begin near row 398 at lanes close to 12-15), so at a reduced display scale the label crowds the data it names; a larger vertical offset would keep the clearance unambiguous.

findings.disposition_note: Both the direct label ('-Infinity at the first read') and the figure caption state the sentinel meaning, so the encoding is disambiguated in text.
findings.summary: The perturbed lanes are drawn as cross markers at a sentinel level near 1.3, above the highest labelled tick (1e0), with no axis break or ceiling tick, so a reader who does not read the annotation could mistake the row for a measured value near 1.3 rather than a non-finite (-Infinity) sentinel; an explicit ceiling tick or an axis-break marker would remove the ambiguity.

notes: Reviewed only the attached rendered PNG (image-0.png); no SVG, script line, or other image was opened for the verdict. The reviewed figure maps to the sole figure cited in docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/slice-profile-at-main.html. The figure depicts residual diagnostics rather than the latency/throughput figure the node's brief clause 3 named, which is consistent with the record's stated absence of any measurement; that is a content matter, not a visual defect, and is not raised as a finding.

rubric_items.contrast: Dark axis and label text and the blue direct annotations clear the white background; the secondary grey annotations (#929292) render at roughly 3:1 and remain legible.
rubric_items.data_ink: Data carry the visual weight: three coincident residual trajectories and one shared per-lane marker row, with no gradients, fills or decorative art.
rubric_items.decoration: No background fill, gradient or gridlines; top and right spines are removed; the only non-data strokes are the labelled 1e-10 convergence-gate reference line and the -Infinity ceiling row.
rubric_items.label_collision: No label is clipped at any edge; the left-edge y-axis label sits about 2 px from the frame but is fully drawn, annotations sit in clear space, and the 'unperturbed' label clears the marker row by a few pixels without overlapping it.
rubric_items.legibility: Readable at a glance: two side-by-side panels with log residual axes, a held-out legend on the left and direct annotations on both; text and markers are legible at rendered size.
rubric_items.table_form: Neither panel depicts information that is naturally a table; both are plotted relationships (residual against Newton step, first read against lane).
